sn1.32:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme || || Atha kho sambahulā Satullapakāyikā devatāyo abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇā kevalakappaṃ Jetavanam obhāsetvā yena Bhagavā ten-upasaṅkamiṃsu || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antam aṭṭhaṃsu. || Ekam antaṃ ṭhitā kho ekā devatā Bhagavato santike imaṃ gātham abhāsi || ||
sn1.32:2.1: Maccherā ca pamādā ca || evaṃ {dānaṃ} na dīyati || puññam ākaṅkhamānena || deyyaṃ hoti vijānatā ti || ||
sn1.32:3.1: Atha kho aparā devatā Bhagavato santike imā gāthayo abhāsi || ||
sn1.32:4.1: Yass-eva bhīto na dadāti maccharī || tad evādādato bhayaṃ || jighacchā ca pipāsā ca || yassa bhāyati maccharī || tam eva bālaṃ phusati || asmiṃ loke paramhi ca || ||
sn1.32:5.1: Tasmā vineyya maccheraṃ || dajjā dānaṃ malābhibhū || puññāni paralokasmiṃ || patiṭṭhā honti pāṇinan ti || ||
sn1.32:6.1: Atha kho aparā devatā Bhagavato santike imaṃ gātham abhāsi ||
sn1.32:7.1: Te matesu na mīyanti || panthānaṃ va sagāvajjaṃ || appasmiṃ ye pavecchanti || esa dhammo sanantano || ||
sn1.32:8.1: appasm-eke pavecchanti || bahun-eke na dicchare || appasmā dakkhiṇā dinnā || sahassena samaṃ mitā ti || ||
sn1.32:9.1: Atha kho aparā devatā Bhagavato santike imā gāṭhāyo abhāsi ||
sn1.32:10.1: Duddadaṃ dadamānānaṃ || dukkaraṃ kamma kubbataṃ || asanto nānukubbanti || sataṃ dhammo durannayo || ||
sn1.32:11.1: Tasmā satañca asatañca || nānā hoti ito gati || asanto nirayaṃ yanti || santo saggaparāyanā ti || ||
sn1.32:12.1: Atha kho aparā devatā Bhagavantam etad avoca || Kassa nu kho Bhagavā subhāsitan ti || ||
sn1.32:13.1: Sabbāsaṃ vo subhāsitaṃ pariyāyena || api mamam pi suṇātha || ||
sn1.32:14.1: Dhammaṃ care yo samucchakaṃ care || dāram ca posaṃ dadam appakasmiṃ || sataṃ sahassānaṃ sahassayāginaṃ || kalam pi nāgghanti tathāvidhassa te ti || ||
sn1.32:15.1: Atha kho aparā devatā Bhagavantaṃ gāthaya ajjhabhāsi || ||
sn1.32:16.1: Ken-esaṃ yañño vipulo mahaggato || samena dinnassa na aggham eti || sataṃ sahassānaṃ sahassayāginaṃ || kalam pi nāgghanti tathāvidhassa te ti || || Atha kho Bhagavā taṃ
sn1.32:17.1: {devataṃ,} gāthāya ajjhabhāsi || || Dadanti eke visame niviṭṭhā || chetvā vadhitvā atha socayitvā || sā dakkhiṇā assumukhā sadaṇḍā || samena dinnassa na aggham eti || ||
sn1.32:18.1: Evaṃ sahassānaṃ sahassayāginam || kalam pi nāgghanti tathāvidhassa te ti || ||
